about_the_game:
This is a crime plot puzzle game with a Chinese local theme. The protagonist is a food delivery man named Li Shui. During the process of delivering food, he met an old classmate from his childhood and learned that the old classmate had made a fortune in business. Li Shui no longer wants to deliver food and wants to cooperate with the old classmate to do business and make a lot of money. Unexpectedly, he fell into the trap of an old classmate and incurred a huge debt. He was pursued by thugs who charged high interest loans, but unexpectedly encountered a case .....

The game operation is very simple. Players play a role, paying attention to various items in different scenes, interpreting and collecting items, and using props in reasonable situations to solve various problems. Each time the plot is unlocked, there may be some changes in the game's scenes, and players can explore the items in the plot again. The puzzles are closely integrated with the plot, making the plot experience more interesting

Detailed tutorial:

No need for mouse

Reverse key/Move

Space key/interaction

Esc key/menu or exit

E key/Use props

Tab key/switch props

S key/save process

Good luck!

If there are bugs in the game, you can join the group to provide bugs or suggestions
